\newcommand{\HmcPredecessorStatement}{13/15 designs resolved; designs 028 and 048 failed the 10 deg level-0 mesh angle gate before any solve; no assessment, gates or verdict were produced. v1.1 changes only the angle gate (10 -> 5 deg, disclosed) and adds the whole-set mesh preflight to the shakedown; every other declaration, tolerance and threshold is identical.}
\newcommand{\HmcAngleGateDisclosure}{v1 (recorded development\_rejection, commit 978c71be) used the fem\_reference qualification's 10 deg gate and lost two designs before any solve: 028 (exit taper 0.254 mm long and 0.83 mm high -> three 5.3 deg sliver triangles in the exit dielectric) and 048 (injector end and first magnet edge 0.045 mm apart -> the structured body-fitted axial grid inherits a 0.045 mm interval; 13,816 anisotropic 9.3 deg triangles, mostly in the anode / injector zone). Both are geometric near-coincidences of the body-fitted mesher, not resolution effects (5.3 / 9.3 deg at 3, 4 and 5 feature elements; improve\_mesh\_quality exceeds 1.5M DOFs). v1.1 gates at 5 deg, records per level the count, fraction and regions of the elements below 10 deg (sliver disclosure), and relies on the true-residual convergence gate and the level-0 vs level-1 discretisation sensitivity for the numerical quality of the bore field.}
